name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems, and emit a single prioritized JSON report of findings plus suggested actions. Read-only and recommend-only.

skills.summary: Performs the single crawl, invokes the four specialist skills, composes their findings into one report, derives severity and prioritizes.
Gate 1 - can an AI retrieval agent reach the page? Per-agent robots.txt, retrieval-vs-training taxonomy, noindex, snippet suppression, canonicals, sitemaps.
Gates 2 and 3 - does the specific fact survive bot-grade text extraction, and is it typed unambiguously? Extraction tiering T0-T3, payload islands, structured data, quotability.
Is the information current, internally consistent, and corroborable? Date signals, staleness, cross-page contradiction, corroboration infrastructure.
Will a visitor who arrives be able to act? Form friction, control naming, link purpose, alt coverage, heading structure, zoom, promise/payoff match.
